text: The Tameeni insurance-comparison platform is operated by Tameeni Company, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Rasan Information Technology Co., which listed on the Saudi Exchange (TASI) in 2024.
short: Tameeni is a wholly-owned subsidiary of listed Rasan Information Technology (TASI: 8313).
